parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationJobIdListJsonStr
parameters.description: Instance IDs of data synchronization instances, in JSON array format. You can call the [DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~) operation to query instance IDs.
